0c49702397:
Footballer Shigeru Jo volunteered to become an electric cyborg to avenge a friend killed by Black Satan.
With his partner Tackle, he travels Japan fighting Black Satan and the Delza Army.
7f7085ab8f:
Hiroshi Tsukuba of the hang-gliding club, remodeled into a Kamen Rider by Neo-Shocker.
The gravity reducer in his belt lets him soar freely through the sky with the Sailing Jump.
eee97e045a:
Kazuya Oki, who volunteered to become a cyborg for planetary development.
He fights Dogma and Jin Dogma with the Sekishin Shorinken he mastered and the Five Hands, tools for planetary development.
77e0efab1e:
Ryo Murasame transforms: a perfect cyborg, 99% machine, remodeled by Badan.
Known as the "Ninja Rider", he fights with cross shuriken, smoke screens and more.
6b50114764:
Kotaro Minami, born during an eclipse, transforms with the King Stone Gorgom implanted in him: a jet-black Kamen Rider.
He is fated to fight his best friend Nobuhiko Akizuki, Shadow Moon.
96529606fc:
Kamen Rider Black evolved by the sun's light: the Child of the Sun.
With the photon sword Revolcane, he fights the Crisis Empire, invaders from another world.
be6c06660c:
The Prince of Sorrow, RX transformed by deep grief.
He fights with hard armor, overwhelming power and the Voltic Shooter, a gun firing light shots.
59fc8ef748:
The Prince of Rage, RX transformed by fierce anger.
He fights with the sharp Bio Blade and many abilities, such as liquefying his body.
ac0d5bbc52:
Unidentified Lifeform No. 0, at the top of the Grongi.
As strong as Kuuga's Ultimate Form, he burns enemies to ash with super pyrokinesis.
fd049036d6:
One of the high-ranking kaijin called the El Lords.
In the Akatsuki incident, he planted a deep fear in Agito, Shoichi Tsugami.
4af2ecfbd0:
The successor to the G3 System, put into use by the Self-Defense Forces.
It was sealed away for the extreme strain it puts on the wearer.
19b0805c84:
The last of the 13 Kamen Riders, who fights the final battle with the winner of the Rider War.
With Time Vent he can turn back time.
767e5566b5:
A jet-black Kamen Rider transformed by Shinji Kido's mirror image, born in the Mirror World.
He seeks to fuse with the real Shinji and become the strongest Kamen Rider.
63bebc664a:
Yuji Kiba, killed in a traffic accident, awakened as an Orphnoch.
He fights with the demon sword Horse Sword and a huge shield, and can take a four-legged galloping form.
efd5b22e25:
The true identity of Kamen Rider Chalice, Hajime Aikawa: a special being who is the ancestor of no species.
Hiding in human society, he comes to understand the human heart.
4b90b8c24a:
A mutation of Ubume's Warrior Child.
It grows stronger by devouring Makamou.
2bc1372d18:
A horseshoe-crab-like kaijin, a leader among the Worms.
It usually acts as a human, Reiji Nogi, but even in human form it can overwhelm the Masked Riders.
8b72804e1d:
The strongest warrior, called the Golden Rider.
Issei Kurosaki transforms with the golden Kabuticzecter and corners enemies with Hyper Clock Up.
04223f9a2d:
A powerful Imagin serving Kai, who controlled the Imagin to erase all of time.
He's strong enough to overwhelm Den-O and Zeronos together.
6b7463af53:
A powerful evil warrior transformed by Gaoh, boss of a gang that raids trains of time.
He seeks the God's Line to rule all of time.
b47e7907b8:
The bat kaijin that the Fangire King transforms into, revived in the present.
It has lost its reason and destroys on impulse.
ae5bb054f1:
A giant warrior transformed by a vicious prison inmate with Arc Kivat, made in Kivat's image.
He crushes enemies with kicks from above, using his giant body.
16a9cefaa8:
An executive kaijin of Dai-Shocker.
This powered-up form gained the Fangire's power and absorbed Life Energy.
175c06ffb3:
Shinkuro Isaka, a doctor specializing in Dopants, transforms with the Weather Memory and controls the weather at will.
He's the one who took Accel's (Ryu Terui's) family.
df788bbe8f:
Scientist Kiyoto Maki, who became a Greeed by taking dinosaur Core Medals into his body.
He schemes to lead the world to its end.
8cd0e9e54c:
Mitsuaki Gamou, chairman of Amanogawa High, transforms: leader of the Horoscopes.
With Sagittarius's power, he excels at splitting arrows.
69755b8ffb:
A high-class Phantom that, true to the name Phoenix, revives no matter how often it's defeated.
Its magic grew with every revival, troubling Wizard each time.
616697486e:
A golden wizard transformed by Minister Ohma, ruler of the land of wizards.
He corners Wizard with the long axe Dis Halberd and powerful magic.
e494fe6524:
One of the Bujin Riders battling in a mysterious other world.
Unlike the other Bujin Riders, he serves no lord and seeks to rule the land by his own power.
2664f3e65b:
The Shocker kaijin who first fought Kamen Rider.
It spits spider thread to entangle its enemies.
c93bde1919:
A Destron kaijin that crushes enemies with the bazooka on its back.
A powerful bomb is embedded in its body.
2f958d22f6:
Gorgom kaijin that always act in groups.
They toy with enemies using thread from their mouths and team attacks.
9e73e8583f:
A bat-like kaijin called Unidentified Lifeform No. 3.
Posing as a church priest, it attacked people at night.
9adf03ca52:
A leopard-like Overlord lifeform.
It chases enemies with legs that move at high speed.
ad25b41f45:
Saeko Sonozaki, eldest daughter of the Sonozaki family, transforms with the Taboo Memory.
She attacks with orbs of destruction formed in her hands.
c2fd8b7ceb:
Kirihiko Sonozaki, a Gaia Memory salesman who married into the Sonozaki family, transforms with the Nasca Memory.
He fights to the death against Kamen Rider W with his Nasca Blade.
7e8bc764d4:
The powered-up Nasca Dopant, transformed by Saeko Sonozaki with the Nasca Memory.
It moves at high speed and slashes enemies.
1b894d1e00:
A cat-like kaijin and the master schemer among the Greeed.
He tears enemies apart with the long claws on both hands.
19cee8bc10:
Kouhei Hayami, principal of Amanogawa High, transforms: an executive Zodiarts of the Horoscopes.
He can take the form of various people, even bewildering foes as Fourze.
86f3093078:
The one who gave Haruto Soma the WizarDriver and Wizard Rings and made him Wizard.
He uses a flute-shaped weapon called the Hamel Cane and powerful magic.
c816916864:
Kaito Kumon after eating a Helheim fruit himself and evolving into an Overlord Inves.
He controls Inves and Helheim plants at will.
23ec77e070:
The awakened evolved form of Spider-type Roidmude 002, leader of the Roidmude.
When his rage peaks, he passes the Dead Zone into a berserk state even Heart can't control.
999dc0ff8d:
Nobuhiko Akizuki, Kotaro Minami's best friend, remodeled by Gorgom into a Century King.
He begins his fated battle to take Kotaro's (Black's) King Stone and become the next Creation King.
d5e155435e:
Shadow Moon evolved by absorbing the Creation King's power, becoming his equal.
He can overwhelm every Rider.
